hello.title: Plan your Umrah
hello.body: This is the Phase 0 hello page. The Umrah calculator and quote request will appear here.
hello.notice: No prices are shown yet. Rates can change without notice.

twoFactor.title: Enter your 6-digit code
twoFactor.setupIntro: Admin accounts need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar). Scan this code with the app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Cannot scan? Type this key into the app instead:

dashboard.title: Welcome, {{name}}
dashboard.body: Leads, quotes and rate sheets will appear here in later phases.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.adminNeeds2fa: Admins must set up two-factor sign-in the first time they sign in.

errors.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the app and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.cannot_modify_self: You cannot deactivate or demote your own account. Ask another admin.
errors.already_enrolled: Two-factor sign-in is already set up. Ask an admin to reset it.
errors.enrollment_not_started: Two-factor setup has not started. Please sign in again.
errors.2fa_required: Admin accounts must sign in with two-factor authentication.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this page.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.supplier_name_taken: A supplier with this name already exists.
errors.name_in_use: Another hotel in this city already uses that name. Merge the two instead.
errors.cannot_merge_into_self: Choose a different hotel to merge into.
errors.different_city: Hotels can only be merged within the same city.
errors.already_merged: That hotel has already been merged into another one.
errors.large_fx_change: That rate is very different from the current one. Please confirm it.
errors.not_found: That record no longer exists. Reload the page.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.name: Name as printed on the sheet
hotels.starHint: Leave the star rating empty unless the supplier states it.
hotels.mergedAway: Merged into another hotel. Kept for history; its names now belong to that hotel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.markupHint: Added to supplier rates before converting to rupees. 0 means customers see the supplier price as given.
settings.expiryHint: An estimate expires after this many hours, or when the rate pack ends, whichever is sooner.
settings.responseTimeText: Reply time shown on the inquiry form
settings.showSupplierRatesHint: When off, the public site shows "From PKR X" instead of the rate itself.
settings.childAsAdultHint: Confirm with the supplier before changing this (open decision 7).

fx.title: Exchange rate
fx.current: Current rate: {{rate}} PKR per SAR, set {{date}}.
fx.noneYet: No rate has been set yet. The calculator cannot show rupee prices until you set one.
fx.appendOnly: Rates are never edited or deleted. Each new rate is added to the history, so saved estimates and sent quotes keep the rate they were priced with.
fx.confirmTitle: That is a big change. Please check it.
fx.confirmBody: {{rate}} differs from the current rate ({{previous}}) by more than {{percent}}%. If that is correct, confirm to save it.

flights.title: Flight estimates
flights.intro: Ranges entered by hand from your partner agency. Shown to customers as an estimate, never as a fare quote. There is no live fare search in this version.
flights.amountRule: Enter the low and high amounts in whole rupees.
flights.rangeRule: The high estimate cannot be below the low estimate.
